{{Quote|You caused me great trouble back on Nar Shadaa. The almighty and massive Lungru was most displeased that I had not predicted that outcome. He has not forgiven me yet, nor has he forgiven you for ruining plans he made with Zonnos of Clan Ajiliac. I think perhaps Lungru might be happier if you all ceased to be a factor in Hutt affairs.|[[Kir Sesad]]|<ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref>}}
'''Kir Sesad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Lungru Nokko Vimmas]], as an advisor. On one occasion, Sesad accompanied Lungru to a party that was held by the Hutt [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
